desc:
📢 Next Promo Code at 460,000 Likes!

🦖  Play as some of the most remarkable creatures to have ever walked the Earth!
🦕  Experience what made them unique and the challenges they overcame!
🤝 Make friends, form packs and strive to survive in a hostile landscape!
🧬 Earn DNA and discover more than 170+ creatures this game has to offer!
🔓  Unlock new and distinctive skins to modify your appearance!
🌎  It's a scary world out there, but you can live it!

🎮 Controls
W,A,S,D - General Movement
R, G, C - Roar, Growl, Call | Command AI to Attack, Rest, Follow
Left Click - Attack
Right Click - Grab
MMB - Ping Location
1 - AOE Attack
2, 3 - Increase/Decrease FOV
Q - Fly/Swim Up
E - Fly/Swim Down
Z - Sleep 
X - Lay Egg
T - Tracking
H - Head/Body POV
Y - Idle Selection Wheel
M - Toggle Map
U - Hide/Return UI
P - Prompt Partybox Purchase
Shift + F - Toggle Freecam
Spacebar - Climb/Escape Grab/Decrease Flightspeed
